title: Payments — Stripe Charge Endpoint Implementation
description:
Implement the POST /payments/charge API endpoint. Uses Stripe PaymentIntents API.

Acceptance criteria:
- Accepts amount, currency, payment_method_id, customer_id
- Creates Stripe PaymentIntent and confirms it
- Writes event to payment_audit_log (NEX-219) before returning
- Returns payment_intent_id, status, amount
- Handles Stripe errors: card_declined, insufficient_funds, authentication_required

PR #55 submitted and merged. Full integration tests included.
